title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval of the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with First Republic Corporation of America.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: This pricing structure is in accordance with the Department's standard and the Department, therefore, APPROVES the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chariman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 00-17).
